theorem: Using the repository's canonical signed 45-term E6 cubic, the symmetric cross product of the 27-dimensional carrier spans all 27 dual directions. The resulting positive algebra has exact growth 54->81->83, and the nested bracket is the signed polarized E6 cubic times the remaining temporal vector.
